elaborate headdress / head covering above the face

justification: Both depict a single frontal standing personage occupying a tall upright field, wearing a large headdress, side ornaments framing the head, a prominent round disc pectoral at the chest, and a belt with a hanging apron-like element below — a fairly specific costume scheme. The biggest difference in depicted content is that B surrounds its figure with dense secondary iconography (serpent bodies, composite masks, a framing border and a basal band of sign-like blocks) while A shows only the bare figure with sparse, blocky, schematic ornament and no secondary creatures or sign band.
